tspan.tspan: L2= sector-level allocation; aSoCC=allocated share of carrying capacity; PBA=production-based accounting; CBA=consumption-based accounting.
UT=utilitarian; AR=acquired rights (grandfathering); EG=egalitarian; PR=prioritarian; HR=historical responsibility.
GVA=gross value added; GVAa=adjusted gross value added (via the Leontief inverse); FD=final demand; FDa=adjusted final demand
(via the Ghosh inverse); TD=total demand (final + intermediate); Pop=population.
